newsitems.title: Dumpster Gang is coming December 2026
newsitems.author: Natalie_Curve
newsitems.contents: Attention all raccoons! It’s Sam and Jake here, developers of Dumpster Gang! We're so excited to finally introduce this chaotic co-op sandbox! Dang, it’s been tough to keep this one a secret... Grab up to four players or go solo as you play as mischievous raccoons causing as much mayhem as possible. Steal shiny junk. Knock over trash cans. Raid snacks. Escape a very angry exterminator. Amass the greatest hoard the forest has ever known. Basically... live your best raccoon life. Our very first trailer is here!!!! If our trailer has awakened your inner trash bandit, please wishlist Dumpster Gang and follow the game here on Steam! It really helps our tiny team. You can also join us on DISCORD and become part of our new community! We’ll be sharing lots of exciting stuff there and we’d love to chat. Welcome to the Gang! 🦝 Sam & Jake
